troodos-mountains.title: Troodos Mountains
troodos-mountains.summary: 10 days on foot across Troodos Mountains, from Mount Olympus to Adonis Baths: 8 stops, 198.9 km apart in a straight line.
description: 10 days on foot across Troodos Mountains, from Mount Olympus to Adonis Baths: 8 stops, 198.9 km apart in a straight line.

Recorded trails nearest the stops: Artemis Trail (0.3 km from Mount Olympus), European Walking Route E4, Cyprus, Main Route (0.3 km from Troodos Mountains), Ta Vrisia Nature Trail (2.2 km from Cyprus) and Governors beach hike (0.1 km from Governor's Beach), and 4 more. Elevation runs from 23 m at Governor's Beach to 1,952 m at Troodos Mountains. Moderate: days of up to 22 km and 800 m of ascent, staying below 3,000 m. The longest day is 20 km. Distances are straight lines between stops, not trail distance; 198.9 km in total.
troodos-mountains.difficultyBasis: Moderate: days of up to 22 km and 800 m of ascent, staying below 3,000 m.
troodos-mountains.durationBasis: On foot: Naismith's rule at 4.5 km/h plus 1 h per 600 m of ascent, on straight-line stop distances, plus 30 min at each stop.

tsurugi-mountains.title: Tsurugi Mountains
tsurugi-mountains.summary: 9 days on foot across Tsurugi Mountains, from Mount Tsurugi to Shikoku: 7 stops, 168.5 km apart in a straight line.
description: 9 days on foot across Tsurugi Mountains, from Mount Tsurugi to Shikoku: 7 stops, 168.5 km apart in a straight line.

Recorded trails nearest the stops: Shikoku Pilgrimage (3.7 km from Amagoi Falls), Shikoku Pilgrimage 27th Kōnomine-ji - 28th Dainichi-ji (0.1 km from Iokido Cave) and Shikoku Pilgrimage 32nd Zenjibu-ji - 33rd Sekkei-ji (1.2 km from Katsurahama). Elevation runs from 151 m at Shikoku to 1,955 m at Mount Tsurugi. Moderate: days of up to 22 km and 800 m of ascent, staying below 3,000 m. The longest day is 20 km. Distances are straight lines between stops, not trail distance; 168.5 km in total.

tsurugi-mountains.durationBasis: On foot: Naismith's rule at 4.5 km/h plus 1 h per 600 m of ascent, on straight-line stop distances, plus 30 min at each stop.
